officialAltEn: A Vice City skyline at night featuring a ferris wheel, cars driving, and tall buildings.
captionEs: Skyline de Vice City de noche, con una rueda de la fortuna y edificios altos.

officialAltEn: A wide shot of Vice City at twilight: Traffic waits on both sides of a drawbridge as a speedboat skims toward the city's skyline.
captionEs: Vice City al atardecer: tráfico detenido en un puente levadizo mientras una lancha avanza hacia el skyline.

officialAltEn: People near a lifeguard stand on the beach in Vice City. In the foreground a woman in a bikini lays down tanning while men walk by and look. In the background a couple holds hands, a woman jogs, a woman sits on her phone, and two men play catch with a football.
captionEs: Playa de Vice City junto a una caseta de salvavidas.

officialAltEn: An exterior shot of a marina: boats, glittering water reflecting the sunlight against a backdrop of the Vice City skyline, a lone airliner in flight.

officialAltEn: A jet flying over a sign that says Vice City.
captionEs: Un jet sobrevuela un letrero que dice Vice City.

officialAltEn: A group shot of a daytime car meet: A young woman in streetwear and sneakers poses on the hood of a heavily customized pink muscle car while other figures mill around tuned-up cars in the background.

officialAltEn: A view of Vice City with roads, palm trees, a basketball court, and more buildings in the background.

captionEs: Hidroavión sobre el agua en Leonida Keys; al fondo, un puente une dos islas.

officialAltEn: Two scuba divers swimming underwater in the Leonida Keys surrounded by aquatic life including coral, fish, an eel, and a sea turtle.

officialAltEn: A lionfish swims among seaplants with a diver shining a flashlight in the background; a boat idles on the surface.
